english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for feeling sad, and with 個樣 it describes someone or something that looks sad.
This is the all-purpose choice for feeling sad or generally unhappy.
This is the all-purpose choice for someone who is generally sad or low in spirits.
Use this when dissatisfaction is mainly expressed as personal unhappiness rather than criticism of a particular thing.
Use 唔開心 when blue means feeling sad or depressed.
Use 唔開心 for the everyday meaning of feeling sad or emotionally low.
